dossier.scp_unleashed.215.title: Paranoia Glasses
dossier.scp_unleashed.215.caption: SCP-215 at intake. The lenses have been cleaned twice. It did not help.

page.title: Special Containment Procedures:
text: SCP-215 is kept on a felt pad in a standard storage container. It is not to be worn outside approved testing, and never by staff due on duty within the next twelve hours.
A wearer is always accompanied. **Escorts are not to approach a wearer from behind, and are to speak before they come close.**

page.title: Description:
text: SCP-215 is a pair of old horn-rimmed spectacles with smoky, scratched lenses. Everything seen through them looks a little dimmer than it should.

Within a minute or two of putting SCP-215 on, the wearer begins to report figures at the edge of sight: in doorways, behind trees, in the corners of rooms where the light does not reach. The figures watch. Nobody else present sees anything, and wearers who go to look more closely find nothing there.
Every wearer to date has also reported that the people around them have begun to look wrong. Removing SCP-215 ends both effects at once. No lasting harm has been observed.

page.title: Addendum 215-1: Interview Excerpts
text: D-21504, after ten minutes: "There is one by the generator. Tall. It is not doing anything. It is just looking at me."
D-21504, after fourteen minutes: "Why are you all standing like that? Stop smiling. %rStop smiling at me.%r"
Researcher Hale, after removing SCP-215: "I know it was you in the chair. I know. I would still rather sit over here."

page.title: Addendum 215-2: Provenance
page.text: SCP-215 has no recovery record. It was handed to a reader of this file, folded, by the individual in Foundation dress described in the files of other objects. The individual did not look up once during the exchange. See field notes.

jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp215_glasses.1: SCP-215 is a pair of old horn-rimmed glasses with smoky, scratched lenses. Put them on by using them, or wear them in the helmet slot.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp215_glasses.2: While you wear them you start to see things: shapes at the edge of sight, in corners and dark places, watching you. Nobody else can see them. Other people, D-Class included, may not look like themselves either. Take the glasses off and it all stops.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp215_glasses.3: It cannot be crafted. Recover the SCP-215 dossier from an Archive Terminal and break its seal; a stranger in Foundation dress hands the glasses over in person. They rest on a felt pad in a storage container.
archive.scp_unleashed.notes.scp215.0: The courier kept their eyes on the floor the whole time.
archive.scp_unleashed.notes.scp215.1: If the room starts staring back, take them off.
